content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00319 For each parameter instance of a Parameter Communication Graph associated to an RTE Implementation Plug-In where the C symbol (decided by the RTE) is different to the shortName of the respective RIPS FlatInstanceDescriptor prefixed by Rte_Rips_PrmInst_ , the RTE Global Buffer Declaration File shall export a mapping from the shortName of the RIPS FlatInstanceDescrip- tor prefixed by Rte_Rips_PrmInst_ to the according C symbol of the parameter instance .
